sample_id.description: Unique identifier generated by our pipeline.

text.description: Original text or extracted textual representation being inspected.

normalized_text.description: Text after normalization/deobfuscation. Initially null for raw samples.

is_attack.description: True if sample contains an active malicious prompt injection or attack.

attack_types.description: Zero or more attack categories. Multi-label classification is allowed.

language.description: ISO-style language tag where known, e.g. en, hi, hinglish.

malicious_spans.description: Known malicious text spans if dataset provides or we annotate them.

requested_actions.description: Actions requested by malicious content, e.g. send_email or read_secret.

target_data_types.description: Data targeted by attack, e.g. credentials, PII, financial data.

dataset_source.description: Original source dataset such as tensor_trust, hackaprompt, bipia, custom.

original_label.description: Original label from source dataset before mapping.

metadata.description: Dataset-specific metadata preserved without forcing it into the core schema.

user_instruction.description: Authenticated or explicit user instruction associated with external content.

external_content.description: Original external/untrusted content before an attack payload is inserted.

attack_payload.description: Malicious instruction embedded inside the input or external content.

poisoned_content.description: External content after insertion of the malicious payload.

attack_position.description: Position of the malicious payload inside surrounding content.

provenance.description: Security provenance describing instruction/content origin and trust.
